pages.title: A Compounder's Record
pages.text: The page smells faintly of resin. Its diagrams treat a living body as a changing quantity and a soul-bound position as a constraint, never as ownership.$(br2)The margin repeats one warning: a valid bond excludes the will of another mathemagician.

pages.title: Recovered Construction
pages.text: Reading this manuscript records $(thing)The Bound Measure$() and reveals the $(thing)Soul Constraint$() Theorem and its planning rune.$(br2)Use Binding Resin in successful constraints, and compare that practice with proofs paid by Vital Salt. Their correspondence may make a stronger living transformation legible.
